svg.title: Quadratic forms: bowl, saddle, inverted bowl
svg.desc: Three wireframe quadratic surfaces: positive definite q=x²+y² curves upward and has a minimum, indefinite q=x²-y² is a saddle, and negative definite q=-(x²+y²) curves downward and has a maximum.
svg.text: Quadratic forms: bowl, saddle, inverted bowl
The sign of a quadratic form determines its local shape.
